## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Given a causal trace ID, collect-facts produces a schema-valid ledger whose...

The system SHALL ensure that given a causal trace ID, collect-facts produces a schema-valid ledger whose facts each carry source, gathered_by, time_window, and tool_version.

#### Scenario: Given a causal trace ID, collect-facts produces a schema-valid ledger whose...

WHEN `build-collect-facts-core` is implemented
THEN Given a causal trace ID, collect-facts produces a schema-valid ledger whose facts each carry source, gathered_by, time_window, and tool_version.

### Requirement: A missing source (e.g. no effects journal yet) produces an explicit...

The system SHALL ensure that a missing source (e.g. no effects journal yet) produces an explicit source_unavailable fact rather than a failure.

#### Scenario: A missing source (e.g. no effects journal yet) produces an explicit...

WHEN `build-collect-facts-core` is implemented
THEN A missing source (e.g. no effects journal yet) produces an explicit source_unavailable fact rather than a failure.

### Requirement: A secret-pattern fixture placed in a source is redacted in the output, and...

The system SHALL ensure that a secret-pattern fixture placed in a source is redacted in the output, and every invocation writes an audit record.

#### Scenario: A secret-pattern fixture placed in a source is redacted in the output, and...

WHEN `build-collect-facts-core` is implemented
THEN A secret-pattern fixture placed in a source is redacted in the output, and every invocation writes an audit record.

### Requirement: Collection performs no mutations of source systems; its only writes are the...

The system SHALL ensure that collection performs no mutations of source systems; its only writes are the target ledger and its audit record, and it refuses to run past its configured time limit.

#### Scenario: Collection performs no mutations of source systems; its only writes are the...

WHEN `build-collect-facts-core` is implemented
THEN Collection performs no mutations of source systems; its only writes are the target ledger and its audit record, and it refuses to run past its configured time limit.
